data_objects.name: passenger_records
data_objects.meaning: Passenger-level voyage records containing identity, travel-class, family, fare, cabin, embarkation, and survival fields.

variables.name: Survived
variables.meaning: Binary indicator of whether the passenger survived.

variables.name: Name
variables.meaning: Passenger name as recorded in the source.

variables.name: Sex
variables.meaning: Recorded sex category for the passenger.

variables.name: SibSp
variables.meaning: Number of siblings or spouses associated with the passenger on the voyage.

variables.name: Parch
variables.meaning: Number of parents or children associated with the passenger on the voyage.

structure.description: Each ordinary row represents one passenger record, with PassengerId as the source identifier and categorical fields stored as labels or compact codes.

uncertainties: The fare currency, embarkation-code dictionary, passenger-class labels, and AgeBand thresholds are not supplied.
Placeholder-like zero values occur in record fields, so the intended missing-value encoding is not fully documented.
annotation_notes: Binary and ordinal roles are based on column labels and source encodings; undocumented code dictionaries are left unresolved.
